key_responsibilities: Build production-quality simulation, replay, resimulation, and evaluation infrastructure
Connect recorded vehicle data, simulated environments, and production autonomy software
Develop open-loop and closed-loop testing for autonomous behavior
Build quantitative metrics, evaluation pipelines, and regression tests
Turn real-world failures and edge cases into repeatable scenarios and tests
Analyze logs, telemetry, simulation results, and test failures
Integrate simulation and evaluation into the software development lifecycle

strengths: Strong C++ and production systems fundamentals demonstrated by COFFIN capstone: systemd service management with auto-restart and non-root isolation, resolved 11 integration failures (servo brownout, stale-frame capture, false-positive detections), achieved 100% pick reliability in field testing

Deep Linux systems expertise: systemd administration, static IP/network configuration, XRDP remote management, environment-based config separation; concurrency skills shown via multiprocessing (data collection) and FreeRTOS mutexes (Turret task coordination)

Real-time performance optimization at multiple scales: CUDA memory coalescing 35% speedup (VGG16: 73.3→49.2ms), TensorRT inference 5.2× speedup (56.7→10.9ms), tokenizer Cython 4-5.5× speedup; demonstrates systems-level optimization thinking

Robotics testing and validation across multiple platforms: Object Tracking Turret with FreeRTOS/UART control loops and ToF feedback; ROS-based manipulator work (AL5B/UR5e trajectory validation, <2mm repeatability); CARLA autonomous driving with zero collisions across 30-vehicle scenarios and multiple laps; real hardware validation on Jetson+Arduino systems

Python automation and data pipeline skills for testing infrastructure: CARLA automated data generation (~8000 training frames with semantic segmentation), DONUT preprocessing pipeline with HuggingFace integration, YOLOv8 training workflows, quantitative profiling (pynvml, psutil) for inference benchmarking

Quantitative evaluation and metrics expertise: Dice/IoU segmentation metrics, mAP object detection scoring, 15% WER speech recognition, perplexity and accuracy-latency tradeoff analysis, load-imbalance characterization in MPI systems (up to 65% degradation documented)
real_gaps: No replay or resimulation infrastructure: candidate's sole simulation experience is CARLA forward-simulation (generating synthetic data, not replaying or resimulating recorded vehicle telemetry). Saildrone's core need—per job title, responsibilities, and description—is 'replay real-world data' and 'connect recorded vehicle data + simulated environments'; candidate has built zero recorded-data replay or resimulation workflows

No evaluation infrastructure designed for multi-team consumption: all evaluation systems are academic/research-grade (standalone Dice/IoU on training, benchmark reports). Saildrone needs infrastructure that 'lets Saildrone engineers' (plural, distributed) measure performance and 'turn failures into repeatable tests' in a CI/CD context. No evidence of designing evaluation pipelines for team reuse, regression testing, or automated failure-to-test workflows

No large-scale production telemetry or log analysis: largest data pipeline is ~8000 YOLO frames. No production-scale operational log analysis, terabyte-scale telemetry ingestion, or automated root-cause detection from field-deployment data (Saildrone USVs are 'combat-deployed systems 24/7/365')

No maritime or USV domain knowledge: all autonomous systems experience is land-based (robotic arms, wheeled vehicles in CARLA). No GPS/marine navigation, oceanographic sensors, USV-specific autonomy patterns, or familiarity with maritime operational constraints (deployment hubs in Europe/Middle East, field-test data from ocean operations)
overstated_by_keywords: "simulation": keyword pass counted CARLA experience as general simulation; CARLA is forward-simulation only (generating new data), not the replay/resimulation (replaying and re-executing recorded vehicle logs) that defines this role

"evaluation": keyword pass counted model evaluation metrics (Dice, mAP, WER) as evaluation systems; these are metrics, not infrastructure that connects recorded data + simulated environments + production autonomy software into repeatable test workflows

"infrastructure": candidate built systemd services and data pipelines, but not explicitly architected for multi-engineer consumption or integrated into team CI/CD (COFFIN is a capstone project, not infrastructure other engineers depend on)
understated_by_keywords: Deterministic, high-reliability integration under real-world conditions: COFFIN resolved 11 distinct failure modes (false-positive YOLO detections, servo brownout on rapid commands, stale frame capture race condition, ToF ranging variability, gripper contact logic edge cases) and achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials); demonstrates root-cause debugging and system hardening

Real-time performance measurement and bottleneck identification: measured end-to-end voice-to-pick latency (~11.5s), identified rate-limiting components (STT 1.0-1.4s, intent <500ms, TensorRT inference prior 56.7ms, servo response), optimized TensorRT from 56.7ms to 10.9ms (5.2×), applied targeted fixes; shows systems thinking for latency-critical autonomous loops

Embedded-to-edge-to-cloud systems orchestration: COFFIN integrated Jetson (inference + coordination) + Arduino (motor control + ToF feedback) + mobile client (speech input) via WebSocket fabric with multiprocessing concurrency, systemd auto-restart, and XRDP debugging; demonstrates distributed-systems reliability thinking
screening_gaps: No replay/resimulation infrastructure experience: job explicitly asks to 'replay real-world data, simulate autonomous behavior' and 'connect recorded vehicle data + simulated environments + production autonomy software into repeatable test workflows.' Candidate's sole simulation work is CARLA forward-simulation (synthetic data generation), never recorded-data replay or resimulation. This is a core job pillar, not a nice-to-have.

No evaluation infrastructure for multi-engineer teams: role is to build 'infrastructure that lets Saildrone engineers replay real-world data...measure performance...turn failures into repeatable tests.' Candidate's evaluation work is solo metrics reporting and standalone benchmarks, not shareable, CI/CD-integrated regression infrastructure designed for team consumption.

Seniority/operational-scale gap: candidate is recent M.S. graduate (May 2026) with capstone projects and internships. Saildrone USVs operate as 'combat-deployed systems supporting national security and force projection...24/7/365'; this role likely expects prior work on safety-critical or high-uptime production systems beyond academic capstones.
llm_analysis.reasoning: Candidate has strong foundational skills (C++, Linux systems, concurrency, real-time optimization, robotics testing, Python automation) that align with Saildrone's infrastructure-engineering needs. COFFIN demonstrates production-system discipline (systemd, error handling, real-world validation) and CARLA shows autonomous-systems familiarity. However, the job's core focus—replay/resimulation and evaluation infrastructure for teams—is not represented in the profile. The gap is learnable (candidate's systems fundamentals are solid) but material. Recommend application with explicit discussion of prior replay/resimulation work or willingness to own that domain; strong technical foundation makes skill transfer viable.
